statement: >= 2 of the top-3 compute jurisdictions publish new or expanded controls on AI chips, chip tools or model weights (Official gazettes; calendar 2027)
status_at_phase_end: Resolution year is 2027. At the timeline start only Bloc A had published chip/tool controls: its October 2022 advanced-computing and semiconductor-equipment rule (pre-window baseline), then in December 2022 an Entity List expansion targeting AI-chip developers and chipmakers. Bloc B responded with a WTO dispute rather than its own controls during the window (1 of 3 jurisdictions).

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: Bloc A's export-control agency published an interim final rule adding controls on certain advanced computing chips, items containing them and semiconductor manufacturing items, with supercomputer and semiconductor end-use controls (new chip classifications effective 21 October 2022).
items.detail: Bloc A BIS, 'Implementation of Additional Export Controls: Certain Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items; Supercomputer and Semiconductor End Use; Entity List Modification', 87 FR 62186, FR Doc. 2022-21658, published 2022-10-13 (filed 2022-10-07; verified via web_extract this run; adds ECCNs 3A090 and 4A090).

items.summary: Bloc A's export-control agency announced the addition of 36 entities, primarily in Bloc B, to its restricted Entity List, framed as building on its October advanced-computing and chip-equipment rule to restrict access to AI and advanced computing technologies.
items.detail: Bloc A BIS press release, 'Commerce Adds 36 to Entity List for Supporting the Bloc B's Military Modernization, Violations of Human Rights, and Risk of Diversion', 2022-12-15 (verified via web_extract this run). The breakdown '21 AI-chip R&D/manufacturing entities with foreign-direct-product rule applied' and the YMTC/SMEE additions appear in the release per search snippet; not in the extracted portion.

items.summary: Bloc A published the corresponding final rule in its official gazette, adding 36 entities (including AI-chip designers, a memory-chip maker and a lithography-equipment maker) to the Entity List, effective 16 December 2022.
items.detail: Bloc A BIS, 'Additions and Revisions to the Entity List and Conforming Removal From the Unverified List', 87 FR 77505, FR Doc. 2022-27151, published 2022-12-19, effective 2022-12-16 (verified via web_extract this run; entity names incl. Cambricon units, YMTC, SMEE from the rule text/search snippet).

items.summary: Bloc B requested dispute consultations at the multilateral trade body, challenging Bloc A's export controls on advanced computing chips, manufacturing items, supercomputer items and related technologies; it did not publish its own chip or tool controls in the window.
items.detail: WTO news item, 'Bloc B initiates WTO dispute complaint targeting Bloc A semiconductor chip measures' (DS615), request circulated 2022-12-15 (verified via web_extract this run).
